summary: [spec-fidelity] migrate re-binds an approval whose findings change. rewrite deletes a whole-line canon comment without leaving a blank line, and equivalent compares bodies with blank lines dropped, so two paragraphs a waiver/hint comment separated become one. F.' in Step detail; the preview says re-bind, --commit re-binds, and brief check then adds prose.paragraph-length (the same text with a blank line has none).
